unconfirmed_adjudications.finding: roadmap_ref accepts only ri-NN item IDs
unconfirmed_adjudications.reason: The issue is supported by repository evidence, but no second schema-valid vendor finding matched it. The round-2 Antigravity error excerpt independently described the same defect, but its truncated/invalid JSON was rejected by the canonical validator and cannot authorize a fix.

unconfirmed_adjudications.finding: top-level handoffs envelopes are not extracted
unconfirmed_adjudications.reason: The approved D3/D4 flow saves the complete coordination-bridge response and reads data.handoffs[0].supervisor_record. The real bridge normalizer returns that data envelope, which the implementation supports.

unconfirmed_adjudications.finding: generic lifecycle hooks must propagate supervisor_record
unconfirmed_adjudications.reason: Design D5 and D7A explicitly keep SessionStart, PreCompact, and SessionEnd generic and unchanged; supervisor_only=true prevents newer ordinary handoffs from masking supervisor state.

supplemental_round_2.effect_on_outcome: none; schema-invalid and timed-out responses were excluded
